description: Generate a creator portrait (Nano Banana) to use as the avatar in generate_ad, checked for hands, face and background defects. Requires a quote_id from estimate_ad_cost with kind "avatar". Finishes within the call; credits are charged only when a portrait comes back. SIGN-IN REQUIRED: connect this server with OAuth (the host prompts for it), or add an API key header "Authorization: Bearer acd_live_…" created at https://aicontentdrop.com/settings/integrations.

prompt.description: Who the creator is: age, look, clothing, setting, mood (20-800 characters).

quote_id.description: The quote_id from estimate_ad_cost with kind "avatar". Required.

save_as.description: Optional name; saves the portrait on a brand profile for reuse.

name: generate_avatar

credits_used.description: The charge that landed; 0 when no portrait came back or the charge could not be applied (then note says so).

note.description: Present only when the charge could not be applied to the account.
